modes.title: A mode for every task
modes.intro: Pick the right mode for each message, and change it whenever you like.
modes.fastTitle: Quick answers for everyday use, at a lower cost.
modes.fastBody: Good for short questions, wording and translation.
modes.proTitle: Deeper thinking for complex tasks, at a higher cost.
modes.proBody: Good for analysis, long documents and polished writing.
modes.imageTitle: Create images from a description, and edit an image you attach.
modes.imageBody: Good for designs, scenes and visual ideas.

balance.title: One balance for every mode
balance.body: Your plan comes with one shared balance. The cost of each reply comes out of it based on the mode you choose, and you can check what is left at any time in the balance bar.
balance.label: Balance

howTo.title: How do I get a plan?
howTo.step3: We activate your plan and your balance appears in your account
howTo.note: Subscriptions and balance are handled by our team.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What is the difference between the modes?
faq.a1: Fast is for everyday questions at a lower cost, Professional is for complex tasks at a higher cost, and Design is for creating images. You choose the mode for each message.
faq.a2: You have one balance shared across all modes, and the cost of each reply comes out of it based on the mode used.
faq.q3: How do I get a plan?
faq.a3: Create your account, then contact us and we will activate the right plan for you.
faq.a4: {{brandName}} is built for Arabic first, and you can also write in other languages.
faq.q5: What happens when my balance runs out?
faq.a5: Every message needs enough balance. If yours is not enough, contact us to add balance to your account.

closing.title: Start with a free account
closing.body: Create your free account, then choose the plan that suits you.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.interim: An interim notice on how we handle your data, until we publish the full privacy policy and terms of use.
privacy.collect1: Account details: name, email and password, which is stored hashed so we cannot read it.
privacy.collect2: Conversations: your messages and the answers, and images you upload or create.
privacy.collect3: Balance and usage: your plan, balance, the cost of each answer, the mode used, and codes redeemed.
privacy.collect4: Technical data: IP address and browser type, in sign-in and security logs.
privacy.use1: To provide the service: producing answers and images, keeping your conversations, and working out your balance.
privacy.use2: To protect accounts, prevent abuse, and contact you about your account.
privacy.use3: We do not sell your data, use it for advertising, or train models on your conversations. We use no tracking cookies or analytics.
privacy.share1: AI model providers: they receive your message, the earlier messages of the conversation and attached images, only to produce the answer, without your name or email, and handle them under their own terms.
privacy.share2: Our email provider: to send email confirmation and password-reset messages.
privacy.share3: No one else, unless the law requires it.
privacy.whereBody: Your data is kept on our servers in Lithuania (European Union). Model and email providers process some of it outside Egypt.
privacy.rights1: Get a copy of your data.
privacy.rights2: Correct it; you can change your name on the account page.
privacy.rights3: Have your conversations or your account deleted.
privacy.rightsHow: Send your request from the email address on your account.
privacy.ageBody: The service is for people aged 18 or over.
privacy.contactBody: For any question about your data:
